test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Ritu __goes to Singapore__ for her holidays last December.
solution:
The correct answer is **'went to Singapore.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we look at the sentence, we get to know the following information.
 
• The sentence is in **the past tense (Indefinite) **because of the word **'last December.'**
 
• We normally use **2nd form of the verb in the past indefinite tense.**
 
• The 2nd form of the verb **'go' is 'went.'**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence - ***Ritu **went to Singapore** for her holidays last December.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the concept with some more examples.
 
 
• **Last week, **she **went** to the market for shopping.
 
• **Two years ago**, I **bought** this car and it's still in perfect condition.
